title: MingCute Screenshot Quality Recovery batch 073
review_goal: Differentiate news, notebook, package, and paint variants with screenshot grounded depicts and deterministic evidence fields.

items.depicts_observation: Stacked page sheets with two centered text bars on the front sheet
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants multiple news sheets stacked behind one front page.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the single front page when only one sheet and one side spine should appear.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot adds a second page behind the front sheet while keeping the two centered bars.

items.depicts_observation: Closed notebook cover with one left spine bar inside a rounded rectangle
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a closed notebook cover with a narrow spine bar on the left.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the bookmarked notebook when a ribbon tab should hang from the top center.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot shows a simple closed notebook cover with one vertical spine bar.

items.depicts_observation: Closed notebook cover with one centered ribbon tab hanging from the top
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a closed notebook marked by a ribbon tab hanging inside the cover.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the plain notebook when only the left spine bar should remain visible.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot replaces the spine emphasis with a ribbon tab centered near the top.

items.depicts_observation: Open box frame with one lifted top flap and one centered front dot
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants an open parcel box with one top flap lifted above the front face.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the closed cube package when all outer edges should join into one sealed box.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot opens the box top and shows one small front dot on the lower face.

items.depicts_observation: Closed parcel cube with one top seam and one right edge panel
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a sealed package cube shown with top seam lines and a right side panel.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the open package when a flap should lift upward from the top edge.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot closes the package into a cube with visible top seam lines and one side panel.
